
Data and analysis related to chills constructed project by Scott Bannister and Tuomas Eerola under the manuscript titled "Musical chills as constructed emotion: How to stop exploring and start explaining" (in prep.). 

## Data

The data comes from manual encoding of papers dealing with chills since year xxxx. The format is .... and the file is [`chill_terminology.xls`](data/chill_terminology.xls).

## Visualisation

- The notebook called [visualise](visualise.html) creates the network visualisation of chill definitions, outcomes and symptoms.
